text:
Happy Tuesday! We're starting off clear and crisp, and the sunshine holds all day, but it stays on the cool side with a high near 46. Tonight is the colder one, with a low around 26, so expect frost on the windshield and a hard freeze Wednesday morning. Bring the heavier jacket today, and the afternoon is your best window for a walk.

Wednesday warms up a bit. Clouds fill in through the morning, the afternoon turns partly sunny, and the high gets to about 53 with a light south wind. It's dry.

The real change comes Thursday. It turns noticeably milder with a gusty south breeze. The models land in the low to mid 60s, though one TV forecast pushes toward 70, and I'd lean low to mid 60s. Light rain arrives Thursday evening and overnight, then wraps up early Friday. It's only a hundredth or two of an inch, so don't cancel anything. Halloween looks dry and sunny, in the 50s.

week.blurb: Sunny and chilly with a high near 46, then a frosty night down around 26, so expect a scraper job tomorrow morning.
A touch milder under partly sunny skies, with a high near 53 and a much less frosty night ahead.
Sunny and the warmest day of the week, near 64, with a chance of showers moving in after 8pm.
Maybe a stray shower before 11, then mostly sunny and mild with a high near 60.
Halloween looks dry and mostly sunny with a high near 56, though the evening turns cool, so layer up the costumes.
Looks like a partly sunny, mild day near 59, with showers possible after 7 in the evening, so get outside early.
Trending cloudy and unsettled, with a decent shot at showers and a high near 59, so keep the umbrella handy.
